title: Enumerate and hash the DOJ Epstein Library
bounded_action: Enumerate every linked EFTA and court artifact with URL, release page, artifact date, publication date, MIME type, byte size, page count, SHA-256, OCR status, redaction state, and duplicate cluster. Treat government publication as custody, not authentication of every submitted claim.
privacy_handling: Do not retain victim-identifying information or inadvertently released private data; quarantine and report sensitive exposure without reproducing it.

title: Parse Epstein flight logs as individual legs
bounded_action: Extract one record per dated aircraft leg with image page, raw transcription, written passenger token, origin, destination, aircraft, crew/passenger ambiguity, and OCR confidence. Resolve identities separately and preserve misspellings and ditto marks.
privacy_handling: Exclude protected-person identities and private contact details; preserve only public-interest identities after review.

title: Parse the redacted contact book without asserting contact
bounded_action: Extract page-bounded person, household, assistant, and organization entry candidates while preserving entry type and identity ambiguity. Do not copy phone numbers, emails, or street addresses into fan-out packets.
privacy_handling: Never publish raw phone, email, home-address, family, or victim data; use source page and a privacy-minimized label.

title: Build an instrument-level Epstein and Maxwell legal timeline
bounded_action: Index complaints, indictments, pleas, verdicts, judgments, dismissals, settlements, orders, and authenticated exhibits by docket number and filing date. Reify allegations and dispositions instead of attaching unscoped guilt labels to people.
privacy_handling: Honor sealing and pseudonymization; never attempt to crosswalk or deanonymize Jane Doe identities without an explicit public court crosswalk.

title: Map Epstein banking, transaction, and compliance predicates
bounded_action: Extract account-relationship, transaction, compliance-alert, escalation, regulatory-finding, admission, and penalty events from the DFS order, Senate Finance materials, and the USVI v. JPMorgan docket. Preserve source-specific legal status and exact dates.
privacy_handling: Do not publish account numbers, SAR contents protected by law, private addresses, or unnecessary transaction-party identifiers.

title: Map Epstein gifts, visits, introductions, and institutional gates
bounded_action: Extract separately dated gifts, visits, appointments, introductions, services, internal approvals, review findings, and policy changes from MIT, Harvard, Apollo SEC filings, and referenced primary exhibits. Record decision gates and dissent without turning institutional proximity into person-to-person adjacency.
privacy_handling: Restrict extraction to public institutional roles and public-interest transactions; exclude students, victims, and private staff details unless indispensable and already public.

title: Resolve Epstein-associated companies against offshore and official registries
bounded_action: Generate entity-match candidates across ICIJ, SEC EDGAR, IRS nonprofit data, and USVI/state registries. Require a registration number or at least two independent identifying attributes before merging nodes; keep fuzzy matches unresolved.
privacy_handling: Do not retain leaked passport, bank-account, signature, private-email, home-address, or full-birth-date data.

title: Reify every Epstein allegation, denial, contradiction, and disposition
bounded_action: Create one claim object per attributed allegation or denial with speaker, target, artifact, page, date, authentication status, independent corroboration, contradiction, and disposition. Prevent tips, pleadings, drafts, gossip, and duplicated custody from self-promoting.
privacy_handling: Exclude victim identities, intimate details, and private-person allegations lacking a compelling public-interest basis.

title: Freeze and inventory the ICIJ Offshore Leaks dataset
bounded_action: Download the CSV or Neo4j release, preserve license, retrieval time, file hashes, dataset version, node/edge counts, source-dataset labels, and schema. Treat ICIJ node IDs as snapshot-local identifiers.
privacy_handling: Use ICIJ's public database fields only; do not seek or republish raw leaked documents or personal identifiers withheld by ICIJ.

title: Rank Panama Papers intermediary and address hubs
bounded_action: Rank intermediary and registered-address nodes by entity degree, jurisdiction diversity, active-year span, and source dataset. Preserve whether the hub is a bank, law firm, incorporator, registered agent, branch, or address; apply degree penalties before person-level fan-out.
privacy_handling: Do not expose residential addresses; publish only institutional service-provider or registry addresses with a public-interest role.

title: Validate offshore entities against official registries
bounded_action: Resolve high-interest entities using jurisdiction plus registration number, LEI, Companies House number or overseas-entity ID, SEC CIK, OFAC UID, incorporation date, and former-name history. Preserve unresolved and conflicting identities.
privacy_handling: Use official public-business identifiers; exclude private beneficial-owner details where law or source access restricts publication.

title: Separate Panama Papers ownership and nominee roles
bounded_action: Split beneficial owner, shareholder, director, secretary, nominee, trustee, settlor, protector, power-of-attorney, and intermediary relationships. Preserve source wording and effective dates; do not collapse officer into owner.
privacy_handling: Publish only roles necessary to explain a public-interest corporate relationship; suppress leaked personal identifiers.

title: Measure entity recurrence across Panama, Paradise, Pandora, and Offshore Leaks
bounded_action: Identify exact identifier matches and strongly corroborated entity matches across source datasets. Keep dataset-specific nodes and assertions, attach the merge basis, and distinguish repeated source custody from independent registry corroboration.
privacy_handling: Do not use sensitive personal data as a published join key; use redacted local hashes only when legally and ethically necessary.

title: Overlay Panama Papers investigations and adjudicated outcomes
bounded_action: Join ICIJ entities to official indictments, pleas, judgments, sentences, dismissals, acquittals, tax assessments, regulatory orders, and sanctions using case numbers and official entity identifiers. Preserve each procedural transition separately.
privacy_handling: Use public defendants and entities from official records; exclude witnesses, victims, and uncharged private persons unless a bounded public-interest predicate requires inclusion.

title: Test validated offshore nodes against public-authority and capital records
bounded_action: Intersect registry-validated owners, officers, and entities with time-bounded public office, contracting, lobbying, campaign-finance, regulatory, sanctions, land, aircraft, vessel, and securities records. Require an explicit source edge and temporal compatibility for every crossing.
privacy_handling: Restrict to public roles, public money, regulated filings, and registered assets; exclude private residential and family data.

title: Run a blind entity-first Panama Papers reconstruction test
bounded_action: Freeze candidates generated from service-provider, registry, and public-authority topology before consulting withheld famous-name or case lists. Evaluate exact predicate recovery, identity precision, degree-adjusted enrichment, and false positives; preserve non-hits as unresolved under incomplete coverage.
privacy_handling: Evaluate only public-interest entities and roles; do not construct or expose a private-person suspicion list.

title: Resolve Trump committee disbursements to disclosed business entities
bounded_action: Enumerate candidate P80001571 and committees C00580100, C00618371, C00618389, and C00762591; extract Schedule B disbursements from 2015 through 2026 and resolve recipients only against exact legal entities in certified OGE disclosures. Preserve raw recipient names and filing/image IDs.
privacy_handling: Use public committee and commercial recipient records; exclude individual donor addresses and other unnecessary personal data.

title: Map federal spending and leases involving Trump properties
bounded_action: Query exact OGE-disclosed legal entities, UEIs, award IDs, lease numbers, and agency records across USAspending, GSA, Secret Service, Defense, State, and inspector-general sources. Keep obligation, outlay, ceiling, refund, room charge, and lease payment as distinct amount stages.
privacy_handling: Limit records to public expenditures, business entities, and official roles; exclude traveler room details and protected operational information.

title: Normalize reported foreign-state payments to Trump businesses
bounded_action: Extract the House/Mazars ledger by payer, country, state-entity status, Trump business, property, date, amount, underlying record locator, and report characterization. Compare contemporaneous policy requests only as a separately sourced temporal sequence.
privacy_handling: Use state entities, public officials in official roles, and business payments; exclude private guest and employee information.

title: Trace TMTG ownership, trust transfers, and related-party capital
bounded_action: Index TMTG filings by accession number; extract officers, directors, 10-percent owners, trust transfers, settlor/trustee/beneficiary roles, related-party transactions, SPAC sponsors, lenders, capital raises, and SEC enforcement events. Attach enforcement only to the actor and conduct named in the filing.
privacy_handling: Use public SEC and OGE records only; exclude nonpublic account, tax, and family information.

title: Build a Trump crypto-interest and federal-policy chronology
bounded_action: Extract crypto-related positions, assets, income, and ownership ranges from certified OGE filings, then independently date token/product events, executive orders, agency actions, enforcement changes, and disclosed institutional purchases. Record only source-explicit causation; otherwise preserve ordering and overlap.
privacy_handling: Use certified public disclosures and official policy records; do not infer undisclosed holdings or expose private wallet/account identifiers.

title: Reconcile Trump person, business, foundation, and case statuses
bounded_action: Create one record per defendant, count or cause, instrument, verdict or finding, judgment, sentence or remedy, appeal, vacatur, affirmance, dismissal, and current disposition. Keep Donald Trump, corporate entities, the foundation, campaign committees, employees, and co-defendants as separate nodes.
privacy_handling: Use public parties and court records; do not republish juror, victim, witness, or sealed personal information.

title: Extract Trump–Epstein surfaces as exact predicates
bounded_action: Create distinct records for logged flight-leg names, observed event co-presence, public self-description, self-claimed estrangement, property employment, witness testimony, proposed calls or visits, subpoena production, and explicit negative testimony. Preserve artifact authentication and legal status for each.
privacy_handling: Do not identify victims or reproduce private contact and intimate details; use public testimony and public-role predicates only.

title: Expand Trump Ocean Club unit entities without assigning ownership by brand
bounded_action: Enumerate ICIJ nodes whose entity names reference Trump Ocean Club; expand officers, intermediaries, addresses, unit numbers, and linked entities, then verify against Panama registry and property records. Record licensing, management, developer, broker, unit-owner, and beneficial-owner roles separately.
privacy_handling: Exclude raw leaked personal identifiers and residential-unit occupant data; publish only validated public-interest ownership and commercial-role predicates.
